goal: Defend or challenge the exact individuation and reason-selection requirements that distinguish relational spatial ontology from absolute locations with intrinsic volitional selection. Determine whether a reason must be restricted to invariant relative data and obey the analyst covariance norm, rather than inferring that from PSR alone.
reason: Translation geometry proves an obstruction only under its explicit input and output symmetry requirements. The exchange disputes contrastive sufficiency and sameness of place; an enriched input or rejection of covariance remains a positive rival. See docs/notes/spatial-translation-and-reason.md.
